text:
maria: Heads up — planning a coordinated rotation of ephemeral image-level secrets (GCR creds + runtime env secrets) tied to base image rebuilds. Need RBAC audit checklist and KMS review. Start now?
derek: +1. Which KMS? Customer-managed KMS in prod? We need key policy changes.
sam: For the PROD cluster we use AWS KMS CMKs. Rotation needs explicit key alias swapping and CI update. Also check cosign key access.
priya: cosign sigs will fail until we update the attestation pipeline. I propose: 1) create new CMK, 2) update CI to sign with new key, 3) build new images, 4) rotate alias.
jen: We also need RBAC changes: the image-pusher service account needs kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey permissions. Who owns the RBAC PR?
alex: I can drive the RBAC PR. Security: do you want audit log capture for key grants? We should annotate the serviceAccount for easier tracing.
maria: Yes — capture both KMS Admin events (CloudTrail) and k8s audit events. Retention for these events should be 365d for prod. @eng-sre can you confirm retention and shipping?
eng-sre-bot: triage ticket created: INF-5021 — "ephemeral secret rotation + base image rebuild audit" - https://tracker.redwood/infr/INF-5021
derek: vuln triage: base image has an old OpenSSL patch. Bumping the base image during this work will kill two birds — vuln and rotation.
priya: Proposed timeline: start Thu 00:00 UTC. Steps: 1) create CMK, 2) update key policy (least privilege), 3) update CI secrets, 4) rebuild base images, 5) run smoke tests, 6) canary rollout, 7) prod cut. Need runbook edits + rollback plan.
jen: Runbook snippet for RBAC PR: ```kubectl apply -f rbac/update-rbac.yaml # ensure serviceAccount has kms:Encrypt kms:Decrypt kms:GenerateDataKey```
alex: Opening PR now and will link INF-5021. Adding explicit annotation and audit label to the SA. Assigning @maria for KMS approval.
maria: Approved pending least-privilege tweak: limit key usage to Sign/Verify for signing key; separate key for data encryption if needed. Also add CloudTrail filter for kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt on the CMK ARN.
derek: Local cosign verify test: `cosign verify --key ksm://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234 image:sha256:...` — ensure CI can run the same.
priya: Audit logging asks: create a Kibana saved search and dashboard for "image-signing" / "kms-access" events. @security-analytics can you add SIEM detection for failed signature verifications?
security-analytics-bot: ACK — will add logs to SIEM playbook and create alert for failed `cosign verify` or `cosign check` errors, and for unexpected kms:DeactivateKey/DisableKey events.
maria: Final Q: Do we need to notify sales/CS for customers on dedicated/private infra? Possible brief heads-up if we expect any transient verification failures.
jen: I'll draft a short customer-facing note and share internally first.
maria: OK team — next sync Wed 09:00 UTC. Tag me in PRs and link INF-5021. :thumbsup:
